title: DojoLiq Classic Tobacco 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid by Vaporesso
description: Vaporesso DojoLiq Classic Tobacco provides a robust and familiar profile designed for those who appreciate traditional flavours. The blend focuses on the rich, earthy depth of cured Tobacco, offering a smooth and mellow inhale. It avoids any harshness, delivering a deeply comforting and authentic taste that is perfect for vapers seeking a richly formulated and characterful experience. This Nicotine Salt e-liquid is mixed to an exact 42% VG / 58% PG ratio, a bespoke split chosen to maximise the specific flavour saturation and wicking speed for this recipe. The result is a crystal-clear taste profile suitable for any MTL (Mouth-to-Lung) vape kit. Available in 10mg and 20mg strengths, it offers a smooth draw and efficient nicotine delivery. Created by industry leaders Vaporesso, the DojoLiq range translates the richly formulated, vivid flavours of their famous Dojo devices into a premium bottled e-liquid. Choose from 10mg or 20mg strengths to find the perfect level of satisfaction for your everyday vaping needs.
